digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and P1 readiness gate
propositions: Empty or whitespace-only joined Acceptance Criteria checkbox bodies must be rejected by standalone clarity and P1 readiness deterministically.
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail clarity and P1 when they appear as assigned values, unless suppressed by same-line negation terms.
A shared pure parser must extract and validate plan structure consistently across standalone clarity gate and plan-review P1 surface without changing ticket-type exemptions.
Sentinel matches must be context-aware: they fire only at line start, after bullet, or following specific triggers (:, =, is, remains, left), and ignore fenced and inline code blocks.
Same-line negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) must suppress sentinel rule matches to preserve legitimate prose mentions.
